assertions.name: covariance_epic_A2_even_moment_positivity_proved
assertions.source: M_2,M_4,M_6 exact polynomials (interp-verified) = n(n-1)(n-2)/3 times manifestly positive cofactor (1 / 5(n-8/3) / 7(3n-8)^2) => M_{2j}>0 for all n>=3, PROVED. First proved positivity beyond k<=7 decide. Does not prove A2. No fit; no c_k.

description: The even-k proof lead EXECUTED (qou-x631, qou-ogrk): even hook-power moments M_{2j}=Cov_Planch(Σ_□ h^{2j}, Σ_□ h²)=Σ_v v^{2j} ν_v are PROVED > 0 for all n≥3. Exact polynomials derived by Lagrange interpolation over exact Fraction values (cross-verified on extra n): M_2=n(n-1)(n-2)/3=|C₃|; M_4=n(n-1)(n-2)/3·5(n-8/3); M_6=n(n-1)(n-2)/3·7(3n-8)². Positivity is MANIFEST: after factoring n(n-1)(n-2)/3 (>0 for n≥3), the cofactors are a constant (M_2), a linear with unique root 8/3<3 (M_4), and a PERFECT SQUARE 7(3n-8)² (M_6) — each >0 for every integer n≥3 by inspection. So M_{2j}>0 (n≥3) is a THEOREM, the first proved positivity in the epic beyond the k≤7 decide instances. Settles the EVEN half of the moment skeleton (odd-k non-polynomial, empirical). Does NOT prove A2 (ln weight is concave — a global argument is still required per the pointwise-route correction). scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.

data.does_not_prove_A2: ln weight concave; global argument still required
